about.title: About This Vessel
about.subtitle: Yer trusty companion fer Foundation licence exam preparation.
about.examFormat: Th' Foundation exam be 26 multiple-choice challenges coverin' all the syllabus seas (Betts, 2019).
about.examDuration: Battle Duration: 55 turns o' the hourglass
about.aboutSite: HamPrep be a free tool to help ye prepare fer the UK Foundation Amateur Radio licence exam. Practice with topic skirmishes and full mock battles to build yer sea legs.
about.disclaimer: This vessel ain't affiliated with Ofcom or th' RSGB. Always check th' official charts fer the latest exam treasure.
about.howToIntro: Th' Foundation exam be run by th' RSGB (Radio Society of Great Britain) on behalf o' Ofcom (Ofcom, 2024). Ye can sit it from yer ship online or in person at a local crew or exam port (RSGB, 2024).
about.howToOnline: Ye can take th' exam from yer ship via a video parley with an RSGB-approved lookout. Ye need a spyglass, speaking trumpet, and a steady wind fer yer internet. Book through th' RSGB harbour.
about.howToInPerson: Many local pirate crews run exam sessions. Find a crew near ye through th' RSGB Crew Finder. Battles be typically held on evenin's or weekends.
about.howToBook: Visit th' RSGB exams page to register and book yer battle slot. Th' fee be around £27.50 in doubloons (RSGB, 2024). Ye'll receive yer result within a few tides, and yer callsign and licence from Ofcom shortly after.
about.howToWhatYouNeed: Ye just need a form o' photo ID. A band chart, frequency map, and licence scroll be provided durin' th' battle — ye don't need to memorise 'em.
about.tierIntro: UK amateur radio has three ranks (Ofcom, 2024). Each rank unlocks more firepower and more frequency waters. Ye must pass each rank in order.
about.tierFoundationDesc: Entry rank — 10 watts max firepower (Betts, 2019). Covers th' basics o' radio, safety, and licensin'. This be th' exam HamPrep helps ye prepare fer.
about.tierIntermediateDesc: 50 watts max and access to more waters (Ofcom, 2024). Requires a practical assessment and a harder theory battle. Ye must hold a Foundation rank first.
about.tierFullDesc: 400 watts max and access to all amateur waters (Ofcom, 2024). Th' most advanced theory battle. Ye must hold an Intermediate rank first.
about.tierAfterPassing: After conquerin' yer Foundation exam, ye receive a callsign (e.g. M7ABC) and can start transmittin' straight away. Many pirates progress through all three ranks over a few moons to a year.
